design_reference: HC-BODY-2TIER-1P5-V1 (HardCore_两档碰撞与1.5GU近战_整改设计_20260925.md)

small.comment: ground radius = 16/(32*sqrt(2)) ~= 0.3535533906 GU via WorldSpatialRules iso conversion

large.comment: ground radius = 0.5 GU exactly; iso screen radius = 0.5*32*sqrt(2)

player.comment: player body size is explicitly preserved by the design; not tier-managed

assignment_rules.comment: body tier only; never grants boss capabilities or ranges

assignment_rules.source: HC-BODY-2TIER-1P5-V1 section 5.2 named families: 普通骷髅精灵(56), 沃玛卫士(73,74,75), 尸王(89,90,91); same-body numbered variants included; not all elites are large

assignment_rules.comment: explicit versioned default rule; new IDs are rule-assigned and appear in the per-ID build table, never silently unclassified

invariants.comment: ra + rt + 0.4375 + 0.05 <= 1.5 for every managed pair; large tier = 0.5 GU satisfies this

notes: The large tier expresses a bigger footsole footprint; it must never be derived from sprite canvas size at runtime.
Player 18px body, attack ranges, skill shapes, damage, defence, aggro and map data are out of scope for this policy.
Per-ID assignment is emitted into canonical_monster_catalog.json combat.body_profile by tools/build_canonical_monster_catalog.py; the generator is the only path that bakes body data.
